title: Want to Choose Better Words?
main_content:
Words might help or hurt someone.

Yet how many people truly think about every word they write?

Two new extensions for the Chrome browser can help you choose your words.

Reword is an extension that helps show what words can be harmful. When users type a word, phrase or sentence that seems insulting, a red line will cross the word or words.

The extension is similar to a spell checker. Reword does not block words. It simply alerts users to language that might offend.

Just Not Sorry is a Chrome extension that is, in many ways, the opposite of reword. Just Not Sorry is designed to empower language.

Developers at the company Cyrus Innovation created Just Not Sorry. They said some people weaken their messages by using apologetic words.

It works like this: When a message is created in Gmail, Just Not Sorry will highlight the words that weaken the message.

A line will appear below the weak words. Examples of such words include “sorry,” “just,” “I think,” and “I’m no expert.”  An explanation of why the words were highlighted will also appear.

questions.question: What can the new extensions help you with?
options: Identifying potentially harmful language and empowering communication
Filtering out negative emotions from writing
questions.answer: Identifying potentially harmful language and empowering communication

questions.question: What is Just Not Sorry is designed to do?
options: Eliminate all negative words from messages
Highlight and clarify weakening words in communication
Create complete messages without any editing
Turn apologetic phrases into persuasive statements
questions.answer: Highlight and clarify weakening words in communication
